Ivy CSM: Heads-up — VitalSync goes live in 3 hours. Execs saw demo p99 spikes and want a short customer-facing runbook we can hand them during kickoff. Key asks: prefill guidance, client batching defaults, streaming failover, and a tiny CSV template for renewal metrics. Can we make a very short, copy/paste checklist? :pray:

Marta CS-Ops: I'll draft a compact Day0 checklist (one-pager) with 'if/else' alternatives for spiky UX. Keep it customer-friendly and include a checkbox for Redwood assist.

Ken SRE: Quick context: model = 7B-q4, streaming enabled. What targets should we set for them to hit?

Ivy CSM: Target p95 < 350ms and p99 < 1.0s. They saw p99 ~1.6s in the demo.

Omar Eng: Draft Day0 (customer-facing) — copy/paste toggles:

```
Day0 Quick Checklist (customer copy/paste):
1) Warm Pools: Settings > Performance > Warm Pools = ON
2) Prefill: prefill.intents = [greet,search,summary,billing]; cadence = 30m
3) Warm slots: start = 2 (increase +1 per 500 DAU)
4) Client batching: client_window_ms = 25 (jitter +/-10ms); max_batch = 48
   - If UX is spiky: client_window_ms = 10; max_batch = 24
5) Prefix cache: session_ttl = 10m; templates_ttl = 1h
6) Streaming guardrail: stream_threshold_ms = 750 -> on exceed switch to fallback_model = "7B-lite-q4"
7) Cost guardrail: enable cost_alert at +15% over baseline
8) Telemetry: provide CSV snapshots at T-24h and T+48h (columns below)
9) Consent: toggle "CS warm-pool assist" to allow Redwood to run a 72h warmup job

CSV template columns: timestamp,route,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens,requests,error_rate,notes
```

Marta CS-Ops: Internal short checklist for CS: 1) confirm warm_pool active; 2) run 6 synthetic prefills across intents; 3) verify p95 < 350ms and p99 < 1.0s or escalate to #urgent-onboard. Also attach the CSV template to the kickoff packet.

Ken SRE: Ops snippets if they authorize Redwood assist: `rbnctl warmup --tenant vitalsync --slots 3 --intents top_intents.json --at 04:00` and health probe `rbnctl health --tenant vitalsync --route /generate --samples 5`. Add auto-scale-down: scale_to_zero_after = 72h no-traffic to avoid extra cost.

Omar Eng: Note for customers: if latency tail stays noisy after warmup, prefer the spiky-UX batching settings (10ms window, smaller max_batch) to get predictable p99.

status-bot: scheduled warmup job for tenant vitalsync at 2026-04-06T04:00:00Z (3 slots) created by Marta CS-Ops

Ivy CSM: Perfect. Marta 9can you make this a one-page PDF I can drop in the kickoff chat and include the consent checkbox text? I'll ask for permission to run the warm-pool assist during the demo. We'll log T+48h CSV to the renewal board. :rocket:
